description: Latest block or block by number. Block number, timestamp, hash, tx count, gas used/limit and base fee for the latest (or given) block on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism. Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"chain":"base","number":1,"hash":"0x…","timestamp":1700000000,"iso":"2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z","txCount":100,"gasUsed":"1","gasLimit":"1","baseFeeGwei":"0.01"}. Price: $0.001 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: evm_block
